description: Varies one input (or a grid of two) across a range and returns, for every point, the buyer-minus-renter net worth at year 30 after selling costs, the winner, both net worths and the break-even year, plus the interpolated crossover value where the winner flips for single-parameter sweeps. Give values[] or min, max and steps (2 to 50 per axis, at most 400 grid points). Other inputs come from "base" or the site defaults. Use it for sensitivity questions such as "at what rent does buying win?" or "how does the result change with the mortgage rate?".

steps.description: With min and max: number of evenly spaced values (2 to 50).

base.description: Inputs held fixed during the sweep.

adjustedValue.description: Home value to use in adjustmentYear; 0 disables the adjustment. Unit: USD. Default: 0.

adjustmentYear.description: Year in which the home value is reset to adjustedValue; 0 disables it. Unit: year (0 = none). Default: 0.

appreciationRate.description: Annual home value appreciation (3 = 3%). Unit: % per year. Default: 3.

closingCosts.description: One-time closing costs paid at purchase. Unit: USD. Default: 20000.

downPayment.description: Down payment as a percentage of the price (20 = 20%). Unit: % of price. Default: 20.

federalTaxRate.description: Federal marginal rate applied to itemized deductions above the standard deduction. Unit: %. Default: 22.

filingStatus.description: Federal filing status used to pre-fill the tax inputs. Unit: enum. Default: marriedJoint.

hoa.description: HOA dues, held flat. Unit: USD per month. Default: 0.

homeInsurance.description: Homeowner insurance premium, held flat. Unit: USD per year. Default: 2400.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home. Unit: USD. Default: 800000.

householdIncome.description: Household income; with filingStatus it pre-fills federalTaxRate and standardDeduction unless those are given explicitly. Unit: USD per year. Default: 200000.

interestOnlyPeriod.description: Interest-only years; only used when mortgageType is interestOnly. Unit: years. Default: 10.

investmentReturn.description: Effective annual return on invested savings for both households (7 = 7%). Unit: % per year (effective annual). Default: 7.

maintenanceRate.description: Maintenance as a percentage of the current home value. Unit: % of home value per year. Default: 1.

monthlyRent.description: Rent for a comparable home in year 1. Unit: USD per month. Default: 3500.

mortgageRate.description: Mortgage interest rate (6.5 = 6.5%). Unit: % per year. Default: 6.5.

mortgageTerm.description: Loan term in years. The analysis horizon is always 30 years. Unit: years. Default: 30.

mortgageType.description: 'amortizing' pays principal and interest; 'interestOnly' pays interest only for interestOnlyPeriod years, then amortizes the balance over the remaining term (a balloon if the period covers the whole term). Unit: enum. Default: amortizing.

propertyTaxRate.description: Property tax as a percentage of the current home value. Unit: % of home value per year. Default: 1.25.

renovations.description: One-time renovation spending at purchase; it does not add to the home value. Unit: USD. Default: 0.

rentIncreaseRate.description: Annual rent growth (3 = 3%). Unit: % per year. Default: 3.

rentersInsurance.description: Renter insurance; it grows with rent. Unit: USD per year. Default: 300.

sellingCosts.description: Selling costs subtracted from the headline buy result at year 30. Unit: % of sale price. Default: 6.

standardDeduction.description: Standard deduction the itemized deductions must exceed to save tax. Unit: USD. Default: 32200.

stateTaxRate.description: State marginal rate applied the same way. Unit: %. Default: 5.

appliesTo.description: 'buy' = a house expense only the buyer pays (the renter invests that amount); 'both' = a general expense both households pay from their investments.

secondAxis.description: Optional second input for a grid.

steps.description: With min and max: number of evenly spaced values (2 to 50).

name: rentbuy_sweep

crossover.description: Single-parameter sweeps only: the interpolated value where the winner flips, or null.

points.description: One row per grid point; difference is buy minus rent at year 30 after selling costs.

title: Sweep one or two inputs
